findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcribe, contacts, hiring, read, email_check, sitemap · Private data: chat, contacts, hiring, violations, solana_token, solana_trending, tech, solana_wallet, markets_quote, markets_build_buy · Public sink: transcribe, chat, email_check, solana_token, solana_trending, pdf, markets_build_buy · Destructive: vat, iban, read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcribe, contacts, hiring, read, email_check, sitemap · Private data: chat, contacts, hiring, violations, solana_token, solana_trending, tech, solana_wallet, markets_quote, markets_build_buy · Public sink: transcribe, chat, email_check, solana_token, solana_trending, pdf, markets_build_buy · Destructive: vat, iban, read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
